footer: General information, not a guarantee. Requirements and dates change every year and depend on the university and region. Check the official source before applying.

faq.q: Where does the information come from?
faq.a: Only from official sources: the universities' own websites, the Italian Embassy in Tashkent, the Italian Ministry of Education (MUR), CIMEA and the calls (bando) of the regional scholarship agencies (DSU). Every page has a source link at the bottom.
Everything on the site is free: the 8-step guide, the «From zero» guide, universities, scholarships and all tools. If you have a question, write to us on Telegram.

faq.q: Do you guarantee admission or a visa?
faq.a: No. The university decides on admission and the embassy decides on the visa. Uniroad helps you complete every stage correctly and on time.

faq.q: What if dates and requirements change?
faq.a: Requirements are updated every year. We follow official announcements and keep the site up to date. Always check the official source as well before applying.
